name: "VENOM"
source:
20-year-old Pepperon is hopelessly in love with game character Venom. So you'd think it'd be a dream come true when a self-aware program (...maybe?) calling itself Venom suddenly appears on her computer, right?

…Not quite.

This Venom is nothing  like the one Pepperon's been imagining.

[From [url=https://amekinoko.itch.io/venom]Itch.io[/url]]
